title: Blue Ridge Boat Charters
specs: Boat features quiet eco-friendly 4 stroke Yamaha motor
Boat has comfortable bow loungers, captain's chairs, large rear seat, full leather upholstery, LED lighting, and impressive sound system
Tours include views of mountains, rocky bluffs, islands, waterfalls, and national forest only accessible by boat
Signed release of liability required for all guests including minors with parent/guardian signature
State law requires all minors under age 13 to wear a life jacket while motor is running and boat is underway
No physical restrictions that prohibit participation in boating, fishing, boarding or disembarking
Sunset and day trips up to 6 people

services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: Our Lake Blue Ridge tours are great for fishing charters, family trips, relaxing sunset cruises, wedding parties or any special event. During the charter, you can enjoy fishing, swimming, relaxing, drinking or any combination. The choice is yours. All tours include cooler with ice, pick up from a public boat launch or private dock, sound system on board allowing you to be the DJ of your charter and life jackets for everyone on board. The boat does not come with a bathroom, please plan accordingly. BR Charters requires $100.00 deposit to confirm your charter date. We accept cashiers check, credit cards, travelers checks, and money orders. Cash is preferred for all gratuities to our staff and
